title: Dispatch: 19.2.4 name-recognition repair from subsystem review 19.2.4.9 (attempt 5)
description: ONE repair after the hard-stop subsystem review eshyra-o9bd.19.2.4.9 (read its notes in full). Captain scoping (Sol's lexer/automaton proposal NOT adopted - use the proportionate design below): (1) GLYPHS (S3): define one explicit supported apostrophe set in the SHARED normalizer packages/core/src/rules/stack.ts normalizeName (normalizeRulesRecordName): U+0027, U+2018, U+2019, U+02BC, U+201B, U+FF07 all canonicalize to U+0027 before index alias generation, discovery and exact lookup; do not touch other Unicode letters. (2) PER-TOKEN APOSTROPHES/POSSESSIVES (S1, and S2 incidentally): in packages/core/src/discovery/signals.ts replace the two whole-input variants with per-token alternatives: tokenize the input once (ordinary punctuation/symbols and stray hyphens are boundaries exactly as now; an apostrophe between two word characters stays inside the token); each input token matches either (a) as written with apostrophes removed (land's -> lands, thieves' -> thieves) or (b) with a trailing possessive 's / s' removed and then apostrophes removed (stride's -> stride, wizard's -> wizard); a name matches when each of its folded tokens equals one of the alternatives of the corresponding contiguous input token. Index names keep their current folding. Leading/trailing apostrophes used as quotes are boundaries. Never strip a terminal s from a word with no apostrophe. Keep one signal per key, every matched raw name reason with its own U(n)-minus-k siblings, unchanged ranking/retention. (3) EVIDENCE: fix the test gap - assert per-name REASONS (name + exact sibling set), not key presence, or isolate mentions so aliases sharing a key cannot mask a miss; the possessive test must check the possessively mentioned name itself; add generalized invariants over real index members for: internal apostrophe + trailing possessive (Land's Stride's effect, Hunter's Mark's damage, alchemist's fire's effect keeps its own reason), every supported glyph (incl. quoted 'Shield' with U+02BC), and exact lookup_rules by-name with each glyph. Keep cost proportionate (measure; no 400k-case gate). Correct the signals.ts comments and the canonical-discovery registry reasoning to match. Host memory: wait until pgrep -fc '^node .*verify-current-worktree' prints 0 or 1; npm run verify:worktree && git commit. Notes; close this bead. No push/PR.
notes: S3: stack.ts normalizeName maps U+2018/2019/02BC/201B/FF07 to U+0027 (index aliases, discovery, lookup/relationship share it); evidence: byName lookup identical across all 6 glyphs for every apostrophe name in every kind (incl. ambiguity). S1/S2: signals.ts tokenizes input once (internal apostrophe stays in token, others are boundaries); each token matches as written or with trailing 's removed; replaces whole-input variants; one signal per key, per-name reasons unchanged. Evidence: nameMentionReasons.test.ts asserts per-(name,key) reason + exact sibling sets: glyph x possessive x quote edges over all apostrophe names, possessive at every token position of a stride of multiword names, Spellcasting's Ability, Ability's Score Improvement, Land's Stride's/Hunter's Mark's/alchemist's fire's examples, no terminal-s strip. Registry statusReasoning corrected. Test cost: ~1s extra for the grammar describe (glyph matrix rotates outer glyph by name). verify:worktree passed (6522 tests). Commit on branch, not pushed.
